procedures.name: OnCalcLineTotalOnBeforeCalcTotalAmountAccountTotaling

procedures.name: OnBeforeCalcLineTotalWithBase

procedures.name: OnClosingGLAndVATEntryOnAfterGetRecordOnSalesTaxOnAfterVATEntrySetFilter

procedures.name: OnPostGenJnlLineOnBeforeGenJnlPostLineRun
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before running general journal posting line during VAT settlement. Enables custom validation and modification of journal lines before posting to General Ledger.

procedures.name: OnAfterCopyAmounts
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after copying amounts from VAT entry to general journal line. Enables custom amount calculations and journal line adjustments during settlement processing.

procedures.name: OnVATPostingSetupOnAfterOnPostDataItem
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after processing VAT posting setup data item during settlement. Enables custom finalization logic and data validation after VAT posting setup processing.

procedures.name: OnVATPostingSetupOnPostDataItemOnBeforePostSettlement
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before posting settlement entry during VAT posting setup processing. Enables custom validation and modification of journal lines before settlement posting.
